name: signal
title: Signal
summary: Cool slate, one teal signal colour, 4px radius, 32px rows
description: mxcli's default styling. Atlas Core is untouched: the theme is a palette in theme/web/custom-variables.scss plus one partial imported from theme/web/main.scss, so a generated app stays upgradable across Mendix releases and is re-brandable by editing a single colour. Ships light and dark palettes that follow the OS and honour a theme-light / theme-dark class on the root element.

files.purpose: Layer 1 — the Signal palette (light): brand, surfaces, ink, density
the Atlas wiring — shared by every mxcli theme, identical in each
Layer 2 — dark palette, variant blocks, fonts, recipes
variant switch + imports — this file compiles last, so the partials win
vendored IBM Plex Sans + Mono (SIL OFL 1.1) — no CDN at runtime
